mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.wbs.selectWbs */ TASK_ID as taskId, TASK_NAME as taskName, TASK_DES as taskDes, TASK_STATUS as taskStatus, IS_TEST as isTest, TASK_DEPTH as taskDepth, STG_ID as stgId, PT_TASK_ID as ptTaskId, TASK_SEQ as taskSeq, TASK_ST as taskSt, TASK_ET as taskEt, TASK_RST as taskRst, TASK_RET as taskRet, TASK_ASI as taskAsi, TASK_RATE as taskRate, PJT_ID as pjtId FROM TASK WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}

/* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.wbs.selectListWbs */ WITH RECURSIVE task_hierarchy AS ( SELECT task_id, task_name, task_des, task_status, is_test, task_depth, stg_id, pt_task_id, task_seq, task_st, task_et, task_rst, task_ret, task_asi, task_rate, pjt_id, CAST(LPAD(task_id, 10, '0') AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path FROM task WHERE pjt_id = #{pjtId} AND pt_task_id = 0
AND task_id like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskId}, '%')
AND task_name like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskName}, '%')
AND task_status like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskStatus}, '%')
AND stg_id like CONCAT('%', #{scStgId}, '%')
AND task_asi like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskAsi}, '%')
AND task_rate like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskRate}, '%')
UNION ALL
SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.task_depth, t.stg_id, t.pt_task_id, t.task_seq, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, CONCAT(th.sort_path, '-', LPAD(t.task_id, 10, '0')) AS sort_path FROM task t INNER JOIN task_hierarchy th ON t.pt_task_id = th.task_id WHERE t.pjt_id = #{pjtId}
AND t.task_id like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskId}, '%')
AND t.task_name like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskName}, '%')
AND t.task_status like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskStatus}, '%')
AND t.stg_id like CONCAT('%', #{scStgId}, '%')
AND t.task_asi like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskAsi}, '%')
AND t.task_rate like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskRate}, '%')
), ranked_tasks AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sort_path) as rn FROM task_hierarchy ) SELECT task_id as taskId, task_name as taskName, task_des as taskDes, task_status as taskStatus, is_test as isTest, task_depth as taskDepth, stg_id as stgId, pt_task_id as ptTaskId, task_seq as taskSeq, task_st as taskSt, task_et as taskEt, task_rst as taskRst, task_ret as taskRet, task_asi as taskAsi, task_rate as taskRate, pjt_id as pjtId FROM ranked_tasks WHERE rn BETWEEN ((#{pageIndex} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageIndex} * #{pageSize}) ORDER BY sort_path

SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.task_depth, t.stg_id, t.pt_task_id, t.task_seq, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id FROM task t INNER JOIN task_hierarchy th ON t.pt_task_id = th.task_id WHERE t.pjt_id = #{pjtId}
AND t.task_id like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskId}, '%')
AND t.task_name like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskName}, '%')
AND t.task_status like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskStatus}, '%')
AND t.stg_id like CONCAT('%', #{scStgId}, '%')
AND t.task_asi like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskAsi}, '%')

) SELECT COUNT(*) as totcnt FROM task_hierarchy
